notes_for_editor: Waymarking.com page WM458Y (Dorset Lookout Tower) says the original tower was built in 1922, taken down, and replaced by a tower opened to the public in 1967. I read that text only through WebFetch (the local cache holds just the page title), so it is neither quoted nor footnoted; the story follows the county list. The 1966 erection and 1967 opening may describe the same replacement, but that is unverified. No removal year is given; the county list says only 'in the 1990s', so the removed event has no year. No staffing, fire, or site-condition sources found.
